component.name: MTGA Stats
component.summary: Companion for Magic: The Gathering Arena

description.p: MTGA Stats records every Arena match automatically, replays it turn by turn and shows which decks win. Everything runs locally; an optional account on the companion website adds sync and shareable deck pages.

On Linux and the Steam Deck the companion finds Arena in the Steam/Proton prefix (or Wine, Lutris, Bottles) and reads the game's own log. Matches, replays, decks, account data and the full card library are available; owned-card counts are Windows-only.

description.p: Built-in AI assistant that knows your collection, decks and matches: waits out per-minute limits instead of failing, needs fewer requests per question. Updates take effect without a manual restart. Replays show power and toughness of 0-power creatures again.
First Linux and Steam Deck release: automatic Arena detection in Steam/Proton, matches, replays, decks, account data and card library.
